new.name: Bahama Mama
new.description: A quick bonefish fly with bead chain or dumbbell eyes, a sili leg tail, a flat braid body and a rabbit fur wing with flash.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it in short bursts over sand and turtle grass.
steps: Tie on the eyes so the hook rides point up.
Tie in a few sili legs at the bend as a tail.
Wrap a flat braid body forward and figure-eight around the eyes.
Tie a rabbit fur wing with a little flash on top and finish.

new.name: Bakko's Phat Azz Hopper
new.description: A big, buoyant hopper made from three laminated layers of 2 mm foam cut with a beavertail cutter, with an underwing, legs and a hot spot.
new.fishing_tips: Slap it down along grassy banks in late summer.
mats: Three laminated layers of 2 mm thin foam, cut with a beavertail cutter
steps: Glue three foam sheets together and cut the body with the cutter.
Tie the foam body to the hook at two points.
Tie in an underwing and rubber legs at the front tie-down.
Add a hot spot on top and finish.

new.name: Baltic Special
new.description: A Baltic sea trout fly with a pearl ice yarn body and a Ripple Ice fibre wing in minnow mix topped with smolt blue.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it along rocky coasts for sea trout with a steady retrieve.
mats: Ripple Ice fibre, minnow mix under smolt blue
steps: Wrap a pearl body on the shank.
Tie in a sparse minnow mix wing.
Top it with a little smolt blue fibre.
Build a red thread head.

new.name: Barr's Stone
new.description: A John Barr stonefly with biot tails, a tippet rib, an emergence dubbing body, a zip bag shellback and hen saddle legs.
steps: Add lead and tie in split biot tails.
Tie in the rib and the plastic shellback.
Dub the body, pull the shellback over and rib it.
Tie in hen legs at the thorax and fold the shellback over again.

new.name: BC Hopper
new.description: A foam hopper with a binder strip, rubber legs, a web wing underwing, root beer flash, an elk overwing and a bullet head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it along banks with a twitch.
steps: Glue the foam body to the shank and bind it with the foam strip.
Tie in rubber legs on each side.
Add the web wing, flash and elk overwing.
Form a bullet head of deer hair and finish.

new.name: Benevolent Dictator
new.description: A classic-looking wet fly with an orange butt, a tippet tail, a black yarn body, a brown hackle and a teal wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for trout and brook trout.
steps: Tie in the tippet tail and dub a small orange butt.
Wrap a black yarn body.
Tie in a brown hackle as a beard.
Tie a teal flank wing on top.

new.name: Craven's Biot Midge
new.description: A tiny midge with a black biot body, a pearl midge flash rib and a black thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under a dry or under an indicator in winter.
steps: Tie in the flash and the biot.
Wrap the biot body.
Rib it with flash.
Dub a small thorax.

new.name: Bloom Caddis
new.description: A parachute caddis with a pheasant tail body, an elk wing, a pink post and a barred ginger hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles where you need to see the fly.
steps: Wrap a pheasant tail body.
Tie in the elk wing and pink post.
Dub the thorax.
Wind the hackle around the post.

new.name: Boy Wonder Hopper
new.description: A foam hopper with a poly yarn underwing, a pink deer hair hot spot, enhancer legs and a deer hair wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on windy summer days.
steps: Glue and tie down the foam body.
Tie in the poly underwing.
Add the legs and pink hot spot.
Tie in a deer hair wing and finish.

new.name: Brammer's Mini
new.description: An articulated mini streamer with a marabou and Mirage tail, composite bugger brush bodies on two hooks and a 3D bead joint.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
steps: Tie the rear hook with a marabou tail and a wrapped brush body.
Join it to the front hook with wire and a bead.
Wrap a second brush body on the front hook.
Trim the head and add eyes.

new.name: Bunny Boiler Bass
new.description: A weedless bass rabbit fly on a worm hook with a bead keel, rabbit zonker body, marabou belly, Laser Dub head and 3D eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly through weeds and cover.
steps: Slide beads onto the bend of the worm hook as a keel.
Tie in a rabbit zonker body with flash.
Add a marabou belly.
Build a Laser Dub head and glue on eyes.

new.name: CDC Adult Midge
new.description: An adult midge with a grey biot body, a CDC wing, an Adams grey thorax and a grizzly hackle.
steps: Wrap the biot body.
Tie in a CDC wing.
Dub the thorax.
Wind the hackle.

new.name: CDC Micro Bugger
new.description: A tiny pink bugger with a tungsten bead, a marabou tail, a CDC hackle and an Ice Dub body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line or strip it slowly.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the tail.
Dub an Ice Dub body.
Wind a CDC hackle in a loop or by the stem.
Finish behind the bead.

new.name: Chaos Hopper
new.description: A small, simple foam hopper with a McFlylon wing, round rubber legs and a white foam spot.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as the top fly in a dry-dropper.
steps: Cut and glue the foam body.
Tie it down at the thorax.
Tie in the wing and legs.
Add a white foam spot on top.

new.name: Chuck Caddis
new.description: An old caddis with a hare's mask body, a woodchuck guard hair wing and brown and grizzly hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles during caddis hatches.
steps: Dub a hare's mask body.
Stack and tie in a woodchuck wing.
Tie in the hackles.
Wind them together and finish.

new.name: Corn Fed Caddis
new.description: A caddis with an Antron shuck, a superfine body, a CDC underwing, a white poly overwing and a CDC collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during caddis hatches.
steps: Tie in a short Antron shuck.
Dub the body.
Add CDC under a white poly wing.
Wind a CDC collar.

new.name: Doctor's Sweetmeat Caddis
new.description: A jig caddis pupa with a gold bead, an olive wire abdomen, a UV brown Ice Dub collar, a CDC wing, mallard antennae and a peacock head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line.
steps: Slide on the bead and wrap a wire abdomen.
Dub a collar.
Tie in a CDC wing and mallard antennae.
Dub a peacock head behind the bead.

new.name: EC Caddis
new.description: An elk caddis with an Antron shuck, an olive superfine body, a bleached elk wing and a grizzly hackle.
steps: Tie in the shuck.
Dub the body.
Tie in the elk wing.
Wind the hackle.

new.name: Egan's Bionic Hopper
new.description: Lance Egan's hopper with a foam cylinder and sheet foam body, orange flash, a macrame wing and Sexi Floss legs.
mats: Golden yellow Sexi Floss and dark ginger Flex Floss
steps: Glue the foam cylinder and sheet foam together as the body.
Tie the body down with flash underneath.
Tie in the yarn wing.
Add rear and front legs.

new.name: Egan's Poacher
new.description: A sculpin streamer with a tungsten bead, a pine squirrel strip body, a Ripple Ice belly and a dubbed head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line or strip it near the bottom.
steps: Add the bead and lead.
Tie a pine squirrel strip along the top.
Add a Ripple Ice belly.
Dub a head behind the bead.

new.name: Eric's Midge
new.description: A midge with a dun post tail, a black foam casing, a palmered dun hackle body and an orange or pink post head.
steps: Tie in the tail and foam.
Palmer the hackle.
Pull the foam over.
Add the bright head.

new.name: F.R.S. Special
new.description: A Maine-style bucktail with a silver tinsel body, a red bucktail underbelly and throat and a white bucktail wing.
new.fishing_tips: Troll or strip it for brook trout and landlocks.
mats: White 210 and red and black 70 denier
steps: Wind a silver body.
Tie in a red underbelly.
Add the throat.
Tie a white wing and build a banded head.

new.name: Flexi Floss Nymph
new.description: A stillwater nymph with a cock fibre tail, a thread underbody ribbed with Flexi Floss, Glo-Brite cheeks and a flash dubbing thorax.
steps: Tie in the tail.
Build an underbody and rib it with Flexi Floss.
Add Glo-Brite cheeks.
Dub the thorax.

new.name: Foam-Back Spinner
new.description: A spinner with a biot abdomen, a two-tone foam back for visibility, poly wings and a beaver thorax.
steps: Tie in tails and the biot.
Wrap the abdomen.
Tie in the wing and foam.
Dub the thorax and pull the foam over.

new.name: Gary Scott
new.description: A salmon fly with a gold tag, hot orange and sunburst crest tails, a yellow floss and opossum body and a polar bear underwing.
steps: Tie a gold holographic tag and a tail of hot orange and sunburst crest feathers.
Wind a yellow floss rear body and a golden opossum front body, and rib it with gold tinsel.
Tie in a polar bear substitute underwing.
Finish the wing and build a neat black head.

new.name: Ghillie's Fly
new.description: A small salmon fly with orange bucktail and arctic runner tail, a gold and black body, blue guinea throat and sunburst wing.
mats: Hot orange bucktail, mirror flash and arctic runner
Gold holographic tinsel and black floss
Hot orange arctic runner and blue guinea
steps: Tie a gold tag and a tail of hot orange bucktail, mirror flash and arctic runner.
Wind a gold holographic rear body and a black floss front, and rib it with oval gold.
Add a throat of hot orange arctic runner with blue guinea over it.
Tie in a sunburst hair wing and finish a red head.

new.name: Ginny Midge
new.description: A tiny midge with a glass bead and a body and wing of pearl Flashabou.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator in tailwaters.
steps: Slide the glass bead onto the hook.
Tie in a single strand of pearl Flashabou.
Wrap it as a slim body and fold the tag back as a wing.
Finish behind the bead.

new.name: Grannom Caddis Pupa
new.description: A caddis pupa with a pheasant tail back, case and legs, an olive rabbit abdomen, olive wire rib and squirrel thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep during spring caddis.
steps: Add weight and tie in pheasant fibres and rib.
Dub the abdomen and pull the back over, then rib.
Dub the thorax.
Pull the case over and split legs.

new.name: Half Pint Midge
new.description: A midge pupa with a nickel tungsten bead, pearl flash tail and wing buds, a silver rib and a black thorax.
steps: Slide the nickel tungsten bead onto the hook.
Tie in a few strands of pearl Krystal Flash as a short tail and the silver wire.
Build a slim thread body and rib it.
Pull the flash forward on each side as wing buds and dub a black thorax behind the bead.

new.name: Hard Body Ant
new.description: An ant with two humps of thick UV resin over thread and black hackle legs.
steps: Build two thread humps on the shank, the rear one larger.
Coat both humps with thick UV resin and cure them.
Tie in a black hackle between the humps.
Wind two turns and whip finish.

new.name: Hare Wiggle Stonefly
new.description: A buggy golden stonefly with a gold bead, biot tails and antennae, a Hare Wiggle Dub body and an India hen collar.
steps: Slide on the gold bead and wrap lead wire behind it.
Tie in split biot tails at the bend.
Dub a buggy Hare Wiggle Dub body, picking it out as you go.
Wind an India hen collar and add biot antennae at the front.

new.name: Henry's Fork Salmonfly
new.description: A hair salmonfly with a black hair tail and head, an orange body, a brown hackle and an elk wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the June salmonfly hatch.
steps: Tie in a short tail of black deer or moose hair.
Dub an orange body and palmer a brown hackle through it.
Tie in an elk or deer hair wing over the body.
Pull black hair back into a bullet head and leave the tips as a collar.

new.name: White Death
new.description: A small white rabbit streamer with a silver braid body.
mats: Silver Sparkle Braid or mylar tubing
steps: Start red thread and slide on, or wrap, a silver braid body.
Tie in a white rabbit zonker strip at the bend.
Pull the strip over the back and tie it down behind the eye with black thread.
Build a small black head and whip finish.

new.name: Kryptonite Caddis
new.description: A caddis pupa with a black tungsten bead, a green Amnesia line body, CDC and hare's ear collars and a glossy finish.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep and let it swing up.
steps: Slide on the black tungsten bead.
Wrap a smooth body of green Amnesia running line and coat it with UV finish.
Wind a CDC collar.
Dub a hare's ear collar behind the bead and pick it out.

new.name: Killer Mayfly
new.description: A slim mayfly nymph with dun tails, a black midge tubing body, an olive thorax, a clear casing and partridge legs.
steps: Tie in split dun mayfly tails.
Wrap a black midge tubing body.
Tie in the casing and partridge legs, then dub an olive thorax.
Pull the casing over the thorax and finish.

new.name: Kobberbassen
new.description: A Danish copper shrimp for sea trout with a copper Lite-Brite body and copper wire rib.
steps: Tie in copper wire at the bend of the curved hook.
Dub a copper Lite-Brite body around the curve.
Rib the body with the copper wire.
Pick out the dubbing underneath as legs and finish with a red head.

new.name: Massacre Midge
new.description: A midge emerger with a silver wire rib, a brown SLF thorax and a tan foam post.
steps: Tie in a small silver wire and build a slim thread body around the bend.
Rib the body with the wire.
Tie in a short tan foam post at the thorax.
Dub a brown SLF thorax around the post and finish.

new.name: Mathews' Zelon Midge
new.description: A midge emerger with a Z-lon shuck and wing, a possum thorax and a tan head.
steps: Tie in a short Z-lon shuck.
Build a slim thread body.
Tie in a small Z-lon wing over the thorax.
Dub a black possum thorax and finish with a tan thread head.

new.name: McFlyfoam Egg
new.description: A simple egg of McFlyFoam tied on with GSP thread.
steps: Tie a small bunch of McFlyFoam on top of the shank with GSP thread.
Pull the foam up and make a few wraps around the base.
Pull it tight and trim it into a ball.
Whip finish under the egg.

new.name: Medallion Midge
new.description: A midge emerger with a white rib, a grey thorax and dun medallion sheeting wings and casing.
steps: Build a slim brown thread body and rib it with white thread.
Tie in a strip of dun medallion sheeting.
Dub a small grey thorax.
Pull the sheeting over the thorax and trim the ends as wings.

new.name: Medicine
new.description: A sea trout fly with a silver body, a blue hen hackle and a bronze mallard wing.
steps: Wind a flat silver tinsel body.
Rib it with oval silver or silver wire.
Tie in a blue hen hackle as a beard.
Tie a slim bronze mallard wing on top and finish with a red head.

new.name: Michigan Wiggler
new.description: A hex nymph with a squirrel tail and shellback, a green chenille body and a palmered hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for big trout and bass.
steps: Wrap 12 turns of lead-free wire and tie in a grey squirrel tail.
Tie in the copper rib, a saddle hackle and green chenille.
Wrap the chenille and palmer the hackle forward.
Pull the squirrel over the back as a shellback and rib it with copper.

new.name: Micro Bugger
new.description: A small bugger with a red glass bead, an olive marabou tail, an Ice Dub body and a ginger hackle.
steps: Slide on the red glass bead.
Tie in an olive grizzly marabou tail and the copper rib.
Dub an Ice Dub body and palmer a barred ginger hackle through it.
Counter-wrap the rib and finish behind the bead.

new.name: Miller's Micro Meat
new.description: A small jig streamer with a copper jig bomb, a peacock and tan Ice Dub body, an olive squirrel wing and 3D eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line.
steps: Slide on the copper jig bomb.
Dub a peacock Ice Dub rear body and a tan Ice Dub front body.
Tie an olive squirrel strip on top as a wing.
Glue on 3D eyes and coat the head with UV resin.

new.name: Mini Flopper
new.description: A small stonefly flopper with a squirrel body, a para post and foam wing, a hot spot and rubber legs.
mats: White Para Post and tan foam
steps: Dub a rusty brown squirrel body.
Tie in a white Para Post and a tan foam wing over the back.
Add a chartreuse foam hot spot.
Tie in barred rubber legs on each side and finish.

new.name: Mixed Media
new.description: A smallmouth fly with a sili leg tail, copper flash, a thread body, a red fox wing and dumbbell eyes.
steps: Tie on brass dumbbell eyes so the fly rides up.
Tie in a sili leg tail with copper flash.
Build a thread body.
Tie a red fox fur wing over the eyes and finish.

new.name: Mohican Mayfly
new.description: A foam mayfly with a moose tail, a deer wing and two hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during big mayfly hatches.
steps: Tie in a moose hair tail.
Tie in a foam strip and wrap or fold it forward as a segmented body.
Tie in a deer hair wing and set it upright.
Dub a dark thorax and wind two cock hackles around the wing.

new.name: Morning Glory
new.description: A lake fly with a fluorescent tail, a gold Ice Dub body, a holographic rib, a hot orange body hackle and a squirrel wing.
steps: Tie in a Glo-Brite tail.
Dub a gold Ice Dub body and palmer a hot orange cock hackle.
Rib it with gold holographic tinsel.
Tie in a squirrel wing and a hot orange hen head hackle.

new.name: Morrish May Day
new.description: A parachute mayfly with a macrame tail, a hare's mask body and an oversize grizzly hackle.
steps: Tie in a smoke yarn tail.
Dub a hare's mask abdomen.
Tie in a yarn post.
Dub the thorax and wind an oversized grizzly hackle around the post.

new.name: Never Sink Caddis
new.description: A caddis with an Antron shuck, a hare's ear UV body, an ultra dry yarn and elk wing and pardo horns.
mats: Hare's ear dry dub with UV
Ultra dry yarn and elk hair
steps: Tie in a short green Antron shuck.
Dub a hare's ear body.
Tie in an ultra dry yarn wing with elk hair over it.
Add pardo fibre horns and finish.

new.name: October Caddis Euro Nymph
new.description: A jig caddis with a tungsten bead, a gold-ribbed amber Flexi Floss abdomen and an SLF collar.
steps: Slide on the tungsten bead and wrap the wire.
Tie in the gold rib and wrap an amber Flexi Floss abdomen.
Rib the abdomen.
Dub a chocolate SLF collar behind the bead.

new.name: October Caddis Pupa
new.description: A big caddis pupa with an Antron back, an amber scud body, an Antron wing case and an Ice Dub thorax.
steps: Tie in the copper rib and an Antron strip for the back.
Dub an amber scud abdomen, pull the Antron over and rib it.
Tie in Antron for the wing case.
Dub a pheasant tail Ice Dub thorax and pull the wing case over.

new.name: Olive Dynamite Harry
new.description: An olive emerger with an Aero Dry Wing body, an olive thorax, a grizzle hackle and an Aero Dry Wing.
steps: Wrap a slim body of golden olive Aero Dry Wing.
Tie in a wing of the same material.
Dub an olive thorax.
Wind a grizzle hackle and finish.

new.name: Paradrake
new.description: A big mayfly with an extended elk rump body over mono and moose tails, a deer wing and a parachute hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the green drake hatch.
mats: 15 lb mono and moose body hair
steps: Tie in a deer hair wing upright at the thorax.
Build an extended body of olive elk rump over mono with moose tails.
Bind the body to the hook.
Wind a grizzly olive hackle parachute style around the wing.

new.name: Pigsticker
new.description: A heavy wire-ribbed thread nymph coated in hard finish.
mats: Hard as Nails or ultra-thin UV
steps: Wrap lead wire on the shank.
Build a smooth red thread body over the lead.
Rib it with silver wire.
Coat the body with hard nail finish or thin UV resin.

new.name: Quill Wing Dry
new.description: A classic dry with a biot body, duck quill wings and a hackle.
steps: Tie in a pair of duck quill wings upright.
Tie in a hackle fibre tail.
Wrap a turkey biot body.
Wind the hackle behind and in front of the wings.

new.name: Same Thing Murray
new.description: A salmon fly with an orange tail, a green tag, a peacock body and a black goat wing.
steps: Tie an oval tinsel tip, an orange tail and a green Nylon-Stretch tag.
Wrap a peacock herl body and rib it with silver wire.
Tie in a black goat hair wing.
Wind a hackle collar and finish.

new.name: Seasoned Geezer
new.description: A streamer with heavy lead eyes, a zonker strip, a V-tied SF blend body, flash and mallard cheeks.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
mats: Flashabou minnow body and mallard flank
steps: Tie heavy lead eyes on top of the shank with mono thread.
Tie in a zonker strip as the tail and wing.
Tie SF blend V-style along the shank for the body.
Add Flashabou and mallard flank cheeks and finish.

new.name: Simple Midge Larva
new.description: A tiny larva of yellow thread with a copper rib and a marked head.
steps: Tie in fine copper wire.
Build a slim yellow thread body.
Rib it with the wire.
Colour the head with a brown marker.

new.name: Smallmouth It's A Bug
new.description: A foam and mop chenille bug with white rubber legs.
steps: Tie in white rubber legs at the bend.
Wrap a black mop chenille body with legs at the middle.
Pull a black foam back over the body.
Add a chartreuse foam head and wing and finish.

new.name: Purple Soft Hackle Wet
new.description: A soft hackle with a copper body, a wine rib, a lavender thorax and a black hen.
steps: Leave a short red tag.
Wrap a copper body and rib it with wine thread.
Dub a lavender thorax.
Wind a black hen hackle and finish.

new.name: Sparkle Emerger Variant
new.description: An emerger with an Antron shuck, a Uni-Flexx body, CDC legs, a hen wing and a tan thorax.
steps: Tie in a camel Antron shuck.
Wrap a Uni-Flexx body.
Tie in CDC legs and a hen fibre wing.
Dub a tan thorax and finish.

new.name: Stuck In The Shuck Midge
new.description: A midge with an amber shuck, a white shellback, a thread body, a grizzly hackle and a peacock thorax.
steps: Tie in an amber Darlon shuck and a white shellback strip.
Build a black thread abdomen.
Pull the shellback over.
Wrap a peacock thorax and wind a grizzly hackle.

new.name: Tabou Caddis Emerger
new.description: A soft caddis emerger with chickabou tail, abdomen and legs, a clear rib and a soft hackle wing.
steps: Tie in a chickabou feather for the tail.
Wrap the chickabou forward as the abdomen and rib it with clear stretch rib.
Tie in a soft hackle feather as a wing.
Wrap the fluffies as a thorax and finish.

new.name: Romy's Sand Shrimp
new.description: A sea trout shrimp with a Glo-Brite tag and tail, a Spectra body, a varnished flashback and gold rib.
steps: Tie a Glo-Brite tag and tail.
Tie in the rib and the pearl shellback.
Dub the body and pull the shellback over.
Rib it with gold wire and varnish the back.

new.name: Thunder Creek Bass
new.description: A largemouth version of the Thunder Creek with green and white bucktail, red gills and stick-on eyes.
steps: Wrap a black floss underbody and rib it with silver mylar.
Tie white bucktail under and green bucktail over, both pointing forward.
Fold the hair back to form the head and tie it down.
Paint red gills, add stick-on eyes and coat the head.

new.name: Thunder Creek Marabou Shiner
new.description: A Thunder Creek of black and white marabou with silver flash, painted eyes and an epoxy head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for bass and trout.
steps: Tie in silver flash along the shank.
Tie white marabou under and black marabou over, pointing forward.
Fold them back to form the head and tie down.
Paint red gills and eyes and coat the head with epoxy.

new.name: Tied Down Caddis
new.description: A caddis with a deer hair back tied down over a possum body.
steps: Tie in a bunch of fine deer hair at the bend, tips back.
Dub a possum body.
Pull the deer hair over the back and tie it down at the eye.
Trim the butts as a small head.

new.name: Tim's Hopper
new.description: A foam hopper with a red flash tail, a ribbed tan and yellow foam body, a brown hackle, an orange hot spot and floss legs.
steps: Tie in a red Krystal Flash tail.
Tie in the foam and the tippet rib, then fold the foam forward in segments.
Wind a brown hackle at the thorax.
Add an orange foam hot spot and Flexi Floss legs.

new.name: Triple Wing Spinner
new.description: A spinner with white tails, a rusty body and three poly yarn wings.
steps: Tie in split white tails.
Dub a slim rusty brown abdomen.
Tie in three bunches of poly yarn as wings, one each side and one up.
Dub the thorax and finish.

new.name: Two Bit Midge
new.description: A two-bead midge with a grey micro tubing body and a blue-coloured rib.
steps: Slide two tungsten beads onto the hook.
Wrap a grey micro tubing body.
Rib it with blue-coloured thread.
Coat the body with UV resin and finish between the beads.

new.name: VGB
new.description: A sea trout fly with a Glo-Brite tail, a pearl body, a peacock sword wing and jungle cock.
steps: Tie a Glo-Brite tail.
Wind a pearl body and rib it with gold wire.
Tie in a peacock sword wing with a Glo-Brite topping.
Add jungle cock cheeks and finish.

new.name: White Devil
new.description: A Maine streamer with a silver tag, a black floss body, silver rib, and a white bucktail belly.
steps: Tie a silver tag.
Wind a black floss body and rib it with silver.
Tie in a white bucktail belly and the wing.
Build a banded head and finish.

new.name: Wilson's Bass Bully
new.description: A chartreuse bass fly with a zonker tail, an Estaz body, rubber legs, a sculpin wool head and red dumbbell eyes.
steps: Tie red dumbbell eyes behind the hook eye.
Tie in a chartreuse rabbit zonker tail.
Wrap the Estaz body, tying in rubber legs on each side.
Spin and trim a sculpin wool head around the eyes.
